label: PF Backlog 573
title: Docs: end-to-end map of feature-groups -> tiers -> license keys -> entitlements -> editions -> packaging (plain-language doc + draw.io diagram)
body: Operators and readers cannot currently see, in one place, how feature groups, tiers, license keys, entitlements, editions and the packaging manifest relate, or the customer/OEM/internal flows. Add a plain-language doc + a draw.io diagram that depict the relationship and the build/CI-CD flow, with every term expanded (per the review-communication standard). NOTE: the FEATURE-GROUP CONTENTS are not defined anywhere (only titles exist) - the doc must mark that as OPEN pending operator review (see the companion item).
